newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Duta Anggada says Q1 net 25.09 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Duta Anggada says Q1 net 25.09 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian property firm PT Duta Anggada Realty said on Monday that it posted first quarter net profit of 25.09 billion rupiah, almost double the 1996 first quarter figure of 12.91 billion rupiah.
In an announcement, the company said it posted operating revenues of 23.10 billion rupiah in the first quarter, against 14.97 billion rupiah in the same period of 1996.
The firm booked an income before tax of 31.01 billion rupiah, compared with 14.55 billion rupiah in the same period in 1996.

Duta Anggada said it the proposed sale of office space in some of its new buildings in Jakarta during 1997 and the profit growth in the first quarter pointed toward a strong-full-year performance. It did not give details.
